scope: Existing metadata-state regression script, actual production helpers with pure/controlled assertions. No browser/device/reference proof.

parsed.scope: Executed pure metadata snapshots/restoration and corruption cases; browser persistence integration remains a separate parent check.

checks.name: Empty and malformed roots restore six OFF slots and no legacy overlay
Only supported dimension pairs survive; unrelated valid sides do not form a new resolution
Every catalog transition survives and unknown values use the baseline
Cross and boolean settings preserve literal zero/false without truthy-string coercion
Semantic-link opt-in and treatment metadata preserve only supported own scalar values
Recording resolution metadata preserves supported scalars without restoring runtime capture sessions
All55 defaults survive snapshots, remain detached and occupy only two ordered slots per target
Unknown effects are disabled; runtime and undeclared parameters cannot become persistence fields
Corrupted FX values obey real individual ranges, enum fallbacks and integral panel policy
Declared capture identity survives while object identity/generation state cannot persist
Scalar overlay metadata round-trips and runtime cyclic images, File-like objects and URL fields are absent
Text remains enabled and editable with existing helper geometry/text limits and no legacy defaults
Image references reject resource URLs, object values and existing-helper oversize while retaining stable identifiers
No new overlay-count limit or sparse-array length traversal; non-record entries are dropped
Inherited metadata, prototype pollution payloads and accessors cannot enable or execute runtime values
Snapshot and restore produce fresh serializable data without mutating the source
Media and transition flags persist separately without storing asset bytes or trusting inherited fields
Frame Pulse legacy beat timing survives JSON restore without seconds taking precedence
Frame Pulse compatibility does not execute accessors or accept inherited timing
Earlier Gamma/Smudge/UV saved presets migrate only at restore and survive repeated round trips
Fresh explicit modes survive restore and saturation old-missing versus fresh defaults stay distinct
Legacy mode and scalar migrations do not invoke getters, coercions or inherited controls
Independent auto-crossfade seconds persist finite bounded scalars without executing accessors
Separate video crossfader link persists literal booleans and falls back to the prior link flag
Channel opacity/link scalar pairs persist independently with legacy fallback and no accessor execution
Old Isolator/Freeze/Analyzer presets retain earlier rendering and fresh finite controls persist without runtime captures
Per-file FX metadata roundtrips real declared controls by content identity without runtime state
Malformed or future per-file metadata is dropped and accessors cannot supply records or FX
